question: Ikimenyetso cy'umuhanda kiri mu ishusho ya mpandeshatu ifite umupaka utukura akenshi kiba gisobanura iki?
options: Kuburira ibyago cyangwa imiterere y'umuhanda iri imbere
answer: Kuburira ibyago cyangwa imiterere y'umuhanda iri imbere
explanation: Ibimenyetso byinshi byo kuburira bikoresha ishusho ya mpandeshatu n'umupaka utukura. Ishusho iri imbere ni yo igaragaza akaga kagomba kwitabwaho. Buri gihe soma ikimenyetso uko cyateganyijwe.

question: Ikimenyetso cy'uruziga rufite umupaka utukura gishobora kugaragaza iki?
options: Itegeko ribuza cyangwa rigena uburyo bwo gukoresha umuhanda
answer: Itegeko ribuza cyangwa rigena uburyo bwo gukoresha umuhanda
explanation: Ibimenyetso byinshi bizengurutse bifite umupaka utukura bigaragaza ibibujijwe cyangwa imipaka igomba kubahirizwa. Soma ikimenyetso cyose kugira ngo umenye icyo gisaba.

question: Ikimenyetso cy'ubururu gifite ishusho yera yerekana icyerekezo gitegetswe gisobanura iki?
options: Guhitamo icyerekezo icyo ari cyo cyose
Kwirengagiza icyerekezo iyo umuhanda ubonetsemo ubusa
answer: Gukurikiza icyerekezo kigaragajwe
explanation: Ibimenyetso by'itegeko bitegeka icyerekezo bigaragaza aho ugomba kunyura. Ugomba kubikurikiza kandi ugategura urugendo rwawe mbere yo kugera aho icyerekezo gihindukira.

question: Umurongo uciyeho udacagaguye hagati y'imirongo y'ibinyabiziga ushobora gusobanura iki?
options: Ko guca uwo murongo bibujijwe mu bihe uteganywa
Ko ari ahantu ho guhagarara igihe cyose
Ko nta mategeko agenga uwo murongo
answer: Ko guca uwo murongo bibujijwe mu bihe uteganywa
explanation: Imirongo idacagaguye ikoreshwa mu kugabanya cyangwa gutandukanya aho ibinyabiziga bigenda, kandi akenshi igabanya uburenganzira bwo kuyambuka. Kurikiza imiterere y'umurongo n'amabwiriza awugenga.

question: Umurongo wera ucagaguye utandukanya imirongo y'ibinyabiziga ugufasha kumenya iki?
options: Aho imirongo y'ibinyabiziga itandukaniye kandi aho guhindura umurongo bishobora kwemerwa
Aho ugomba guhagarara burundu igihe cyose
answer: Aho imirongo y'ibinyabiziga itandukaniye kandi aho guhindura umurongo bishobora kwemerwa
explanation: Umurongo ucagaguye utandukanya imirongo y'ibinyabiziga. Guhindura umurongo byemerwa gusa igihe amategeko abiteganya kandi nta kaga biteje.

question: Umurongo wera mugari uri ku muhanda mbere y'amasangano ushobora gusobanura iki?
options: Aho ikinyabiziga kigomba guhagarara igihe amabwiriza abisaba
answer: Aho ikinyabiziga kigomba guhagarara igihe amabwiriza abisaba
explanation: Umurongo wo guhagararaho werekana aho ikinyabiziga kigomba guhagarara iyo itara, ikimenyetso cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha abisabye. Guhagarara neza bifasha gusigasira umutekano w'amasangano.

question: Umushoferi ugeze ku cyapa cya GIVE WAY agomba gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no guha inzira abafite uburenganzira bwo kunyura
Gufunga inzira y'abandi kugira ngo anyure mbere
Guhagarara umwanya uhamye nubwo nta kinyabiziga kiri hafi
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no guha inzira abafite uburenganzira bwo kunyura
explanation: Icyapa cya GIVE WAY gisaba guha inzira ibinyabiziga bifite uburenganzira bwo kunyura. Ugomba kugenzura urujya n'uruza no guhagarara igihe bibaye ngombwa kugira ngo unyure mu mutekano.

question: Iyo ubonye icyapa cya NO ENTRY imbere yawe, ukwiye gukora iki?
options: Kutinjira muri iyo nzira no gushaka indi nzira yemewe
answer: Kutinjira muri iyo nzira no gushaka indi nzira yemewe
explanation: NO ENTRY ni ikimenyetso kibuza kwinjira mu nzira cyerekezaho. Kwinjira bishobora gutuma uhura n'ibinyabiziga biva mu cyerekezo kitagenewe wowe.

question: Ikimenyetso kibuza guhindukira ukora U-turn kigomba kubahirizwa gute?
options: Kwirinda gukora U-turn aho icyo kimenyetso kibereye
Guhindukira gusa iyo nta mupolisi uhari
answer: Kwirinda gukora U-turn aho icyo kimenyetso kibereye
explanation: Ikimenyetso kibuza U-turn kigomba kubahirizwa. Guhindukira aho bibujijwe bishobora gutungura abandi bakoresha umuhanda no guteza impanuka.

question: Ikimenyetso kibuza guhindukira ibumoso gisobanura iki?
options: Ko udakwiye guhindukira ibumoso aho icyo kimenyetso gikurikizwa
Ko ugomba guhindukira ibumoso ako kanya
Ko ushobora guhindukira ibumoso igihe cyose nta modoka ihari
Ko umuhanda ufunze mu byerekezo byose
answer: Ko udakwiye guhindukira ibumoso aho icyo kimenyetso gikurikizwa
explanation: Ikimenyetso kibuza guhindukira ibumoso kibuza icyo gikorwa aho cyashyizwe. Tegura icyerekezo cyawe hakiri kare kugira ngo utagira igikorwa giteje akaga.

question: Ikimenyetso kibuza guhindukira iburyo kigomba kugufasha gufata uwuhe mwanzuro?
options: Gukomeza mu cyerekezo cyemewe cyangwa gushaka indi nzira
Kunyura ku ruhande rw'umuhanda utabanje kugenzura
answer: Gukomeza mu cyerekezo cyemewe cyangwa gushaka indi nzira
explanation: Iyo guhindukira iburyo bibujijwe, ugomba guhitamo icyerekezo cyemewe. Guhindukira buhoro ntibihindura igikorwa kibujijwe ngo cyemewe.

question: Iyo ubonye ikimenyetso kibuza kunyura ku kindi kinyabiziga, ni iki ukwiye gukora?
options: Kuguma mu murongo wawe no kutarenza ikinyabiziga kiri imbere aho bibujijwe
Kunyura ku ruhande igihe cyose nta modoka ihari
Kunyura niba ikinyabiziga kiri imbere kigenda buhoro
answer: Kuguma mu murongo wawe no kutarenza ikinyabiziga kiri imbere aho bibujijwe
explanation: Ikimenyetso kibuza kurenza ikinyabiziga kigamije kugabanya ibyago byo kugongana. Tegereza kugeza ugeze ahantu amategeko yemera ko urenga ikindi kinyabiziga kandi ukabikora mu mutekano.

question: Ikimenyetso cy'umuvuduko ntarengwa wa 40 km/h gisobanura iki?
options: Ko utagomba kurenza 40 km/h aho icyo kimenyetso gikurikizwa
Ko ugomba kugendera kuri 40 km/h buri gihe
Ko umuvuduko muto wemewe ari 40 km/h
Ko ushobora kugendera kuri 60 km/h iyo umuhanda ari ubusa
answer: Ko utagomba kurenza 40 km/h aho icyo kimenyetso gikurikizwa
explanation: Umubare uri ku kimenyetso cy'umuvuduko ntarengwa ugaragaza umuvuduko utagomba kurengwa. Nubwo utarenga uwo mubare, ushobora gukenera kugenda buhoro bitewe n'ikirere, umuhanda n'abantu bawukoresha.

question: Iyo ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko umuvuduko ntarengwa warangiye, umushoferi agomba gukora iki?
options: Gukurikiza umuvuduko wemewe ku gice cy'umuhanda arimo no kugendana n'imiterere yawo
Guhita agendera ku muvuduko wo hejuru cyane
Gutekereza ko nta mipaka y'umuvuduko isigaye
answer: Gukurikiza umuvuduko wemewe ku gice cy'umuhanda arimo no kugendana n'imiterere yawo
explanation: Kurangira kw'ikimenyetso runaka ntibivuga ko umuvuduko uwo ari wo wose wemerewe. Umushoferi agomba gukurikiza amabwiriza akurikizwa kuri uwo muhanda no kugenda mu buryo butekanye.

question: Ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari ishuri kigamije kukumenyesha iki?
options: Ko hashobora kuba abana bambuka cyangwa begereye umuhanda
Ko abana bemerewe gukina hagati mu muhanda
Ko ibinyabiziga bidashobora kunyura muri ako gace
answer: Ko hashobora kuba abana bambuka cyangwa begereye umuhanda
explanation: Ahari ishuri hashobora kuba abana bagenda cyangwa bambuka mu buryo butunguranye. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi urebe neza impande z'umuhanda.

question: Ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari aho abanyamaguru bambukira kigomba kugutera gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guha abanyamaguru inzira
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo uharenge vuba
Gukoresha ihoni aho guhagarara igihe bikenewe
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guha abanyamaguru inzira
explanation: Ikimenyetso kiburira aho abanyamaguru bambukira kigusaba kwitegura ko hashobora kuba abantu mu nzira. Witondere kandi ukurikize amabwiriza agenga uburenganzira bwo kwambuka.

question: Ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari amatungo ashobora kwambuka umuhanda gisobanura iki?
options: Ko ugomba kwitegura kugabanya umuvuduko kubera amatungo ashobora kuba mu nzira
Ko amatungo afite uburenganzira bwo kwinjira mu modoka
answer: Ko ugomba kwitegura kugabanya umuvuduko kubera amatungo ashobora kuba mu nzira
explanation: Amatungo ashobora kwambuka cyangwa kwinjira mu muhanda mu buryo butunguranye. Kugenda witonze biguha umwanya wo kwitabara no kwirinda kuyagonga.

question: Ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari umuhanda unyura kuri gari ya moshi nta nzitizi gisaba iki?
options: Kugera aho unyura witonze, kureba no kumva niba gari ya moshi iri hafi, no kubahiriza ibimenyetso
Guhagarara ku murongo wa gari ya moshi kugira ngo urebe neza
Kwirengagiza inzogera kuko nta nzitizi ihari
answer: Kugera aho unyura witonze, kureba no kumva niba gari ya moshi iri hafi, no kubahiriza ibimenyetso
explanation: Iyo nta nzitizi ihari, ibyo ntibivuga ko nta gari ya moshi ishobora kuza. Kurikiza ibimenyetso n'amabwiriza kandi ntukambuke igihe bitari mu mutekano.

question: Ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari umusozi umanuka cyane kigamije kukumenyesha iki?
options: Ko ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko hakiri kare no kugenzura ikinyabiziga igihe umanuka
Ko ugomba kuzimya moteri igihe umanuka
Ko ugomba gushyira ikinyabiziga muri neutral kugira ngo cyihute
Ko ugomba guhagarara hagati mu muhanda
answer: Ko ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko hakiri kare no kugenzura ikinyabiziga igihe umanuka
explanation: Umusozi umanuka cyane ushobora gutuma ikinyabiziga cyongera umuvuduko. Gukoresha uburyo bukwiye bwo kugenzura umuvuduko no gukurikiza amabwiriza y'ikinyabiziga bifasha kwirinda gutakaza ubushobozi bwo kugenzura.

question: Ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari ikoni rikaze kigamije kukumenyesha iki?
options: Ko ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko mbere yo kugera ku ikoni
Ko ugomba gufata feri cyane uri hagati mu ikoni uko bishoboka kose
Ko ugomba kunyura mu murongo w'abandi
Ko ushobora kurenza ikinyabiziga uri mu ikoni
answer: Ko ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko mbere yo kugera ku ikoni
explanation: Kugabanya umuvuduko mbere y'ikoni bigufasha kugumana ubushobozi bwo kugenzura ikinyabiziga. Gufata ibyemezo bitunguranye uri mu ikoni bishobora gutuma utakaza uburinganire.

question: Iyo ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere umuhanda ugabanyuka ubugari ku ruhande rumwe gihari, ukwiye gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guhindura uko unyura mu mutekano
Kuguma ku muvuduko umwe utitaye ku bandi
Guhatira ibinyabiziga biri imbere kuva mu nzira
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guhindura uko unyura mu mutekano
explanation: Umuhanda ugabanyutse ubugari ugabanya umwanya wo kunyuramo. Reba ibinyabiziga biri hafi, ukurikize ibimenyetso kandi wirinde kwinjira mu mwanya utagufitiye umutekano.

question: Ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari umuhanda uhuye n'undi mu buryo bwa T kigufasha gukora iki?
options: Kwitegura kugabanya umuvuduko no kugenzura icyerekezo ugomba gukurikiza
Gukomeza ugororotse nubwo umuhanda urangirira aho
Gutekereza ko ufite uburenganzira bwo kunyura mbere ya bose
answer: Kwitegura kugabanya umuvuduko no kugenzura icyerekezo ugomba gukurikiza
explanation: Amasangano ameze nka T asaba gutegura aho ugiye kunyura no kugenzura ibinyabiziga biva mu byerekezo bihura. Ntukinjire mu nzira utabanje kureba ko bishoboka mu mutekano.

question: Iyo ubonye icyapa cyerekana ko umuhanda ari icyerekezo kimwe, ukwiye kumva iki?
options: Ko ibinyabiziga bigomba kugendera mu cyerekezo cyagenwe
Ko ibinyabiziga bishobora kugendera mu byerekezo byombi
Ko imodoka zose zigomba gusubira inyuma
answer: Ko ibinyabiziga bigomba kugendera mu cyerekezo cyagenwe
explanation: Umuhanda w'icyerekezo kimwe ugenewe urujya n'uruza mu cyerekezo cyagaragajwe. Kwinjira mu cyerekezo kitari cyo bishobora guteza impanuka ikomeye.

question: Ikimenyetso cyerekana ahantu imodoka zemerewe guhagarara kigufasha kumenya iki?
options: Ahantu hagenwe ho guhagarika ikinyabiziga hakurikijwe amabwiriza ahari
Ahantu hose ushobora guhagarara nta mbogamizi
answer: Ahantu hagenwe ho guhagarika ikinyabiziga hakurikijwe amabwiriza ahari
explanation: Ikimenyetso cya parikingi kigaragaza ahantu hagenewe guhagarika ikinyabiziga. Reba niba hari amasaha, ubwoko bw'ikinyabiziga cyangwa andi mabwiriza agenga aho hantu.

question: Iyo ubonye icyapa cyerekana ibitaro hafi y'umuhanda, icyo kimenyetso kiba kigamije iki?
options: Kukwereka aho ibitaro biherereye cyangwa icyerekezo kibijyamo
Kukubwira guhagarika imodoka hagati mu muhanda
answer: Kukwereka aho ibitaro biherereye cyangwa icyerekezo kibijyamo
explanation: Ibimenyetso by'amakuru bigaragaza ahantu cyangwa serivisi ziri hafi. Bikurikirane kugira ngo ubone aho ugiye utabangamiye urujya n'uruza.

question: Iyo ubonye icyapa cyerekana ahantu ho gutanga lisansi, icyo kimenyetso gisobanura iki?
options: Ko hari sitasiyo ya lisansi ahagaragajwe cyangwa hafi aho
Ko ugomba guhita uhagarara mu murongo urimo
Ko ushobora kuzuza lisansi uri mu muhanda
Ko umuvuduko ntarengwa uhindutse byanze bikunze
answer: Ko hari sitasiyo ya lisansi ahagaragajwe cyangwa hafi aho
explanation: Ibimenyetso by'amakuru bifasha abagenzi kubona serivisi. Guhagarara cyangwa kwinjira muri sitasiyo bigomba gukorwa ahabugenewe kandi bitabangamiye abandi.

question: Iyo ubonye icyapa cyerekana aho abanyamaguru bagenewe kunyura, ni iyihe myitwarire ikwiye?
options: Gukoresha inzira yagenewe abanyamaguru no kwirinda kuyihagarikamo ikinyabiziga
Gupakira imodoka kuri iyo nzira igihe cyose
Gukoresha inzira y'abanyamaguru mu guca ku zindi modoka
Kwirengagiza icyo kimenyetso iyo umuhanda ugaragara nk'ubusa
answer: Gukoresha inzira yagenewe abanyamaguru no kwirinda kuyihagarikamo ikinyabiziga
explanation: Inzira y'abanyamaguru yagenewe kubafasha kugenda batabangamiwe n'ibinyabiziga. Kuyifunga bishobora kubahatira kwinjira mu muhanda w'ibinyabiziga.

question: Iyo ubonye icyapa cyerekana inzira yihariye y'amagare, ugomba kwitondera iki?
options: Kwirinda kwinjira cyangwa guhagarara muri iyo nzira mu buryo butemewe
Kuyikoresha nk'ahantu ho guhagarara igihe cyose
Kuyifata nk'umurongo wo guca ku zindi modoka
answer: Kwirinda kwinjira cyangwa guhagarara muri iyo nzira mu buryo butemewe
explanation: Inzira yihariye y'amagare igamije kurinda abayakoresha no kubaha umwanya. Kuyinjiramo utabyemerewe bishobora kubateza akaga.

question: Iyo ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko umuhanda ufunze imbere gihari, ukwiye gukora iki?
options: Gukurikiza inzira y'inyongera cyangwa icyerekezo cyemewe
Kunyura ahafunzwe niba imodoka ari nto
answer: Gukurikiza inzira y'inyongera cyangwa icyerekezo cyemewe
explanation: Umuhanda ushobora gufungwa kubera imirimo, impanuka cyangwa izindi mpamvu z'umutekano. Kurikiza ibimenyetso biyobora abandi bakoresha umuhanda mu nzira yemewe.

question: Iyo ugeze ku ruziga rw'amasangano (roundabout), ni iki ugomba gukora mbere yo kwinjira?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibinyabiziga biri imbere no kubaha uburenganzira bwo kunyura hakurikijwe ibimenyetso
Kwinjira utarebye kuko buri gihe ari wowe unyura mbere
Guhagarara hagati y'uruziga kugira ngo utegure icyerekezo
Kunyura mu cyerekezo icyo ari cyo cyose
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibinyabiziga biri imbere no kubaha uburenganzira bwo kunyura hakurikijwe ibimenyetso
explanation: Uruziga rw'amasangano rusaba kugenzura ibinyabiziga biri hafi no gukurikiza ibimenyetso bigena uburenganzira bwo kunyura. Tegura icyerekezo cyawe kandi utange ikimenyetso igihe bikenewe.

question: Iyo ugeze ku ruziga rw'amasangano ukaba ushaka gusohokera ku nzira ikurikira, ni iki kigufasha kubikora neza?
options: Gukurikiza umurongo wawe, kugenzura impande no gutanga ikimenyetso mu gihe gikwiye
Guhagarara mu ruziga kugira ngo abandi bagutambuke
answer: Gukurikiza umurongo wawe, kugenzura impande no gutanga ikimenyetso mu gihe gikwiye
explanation: Gutegura aho usohokera no kugenzura impande bigufasha kutabangamira ibindi binyabiziga. Ikimenyetso kigomba gutangwa ku gihe kugira ngo abandi bumve icyerekezo cyawe.

question: Iyo umuhanda ugabanyijwemo imirongo myinshi igana mu cyerekezo kimwe, ugomba guhitamo umurongo ute?
options: Umurongo uhuye n'icyerekezo cyawe n'ibikorwa uteganya, ukurikije ibimenyetso
Umurongo urimo imodoka nyinshi buri gihe
Umurongo uwo ari wo wose nta kugenzura
answer: Umurongo uhuye n'icyerekezo cyawe n'ibikorwa uteganya, ukurikije ibimenyetso
explanation: Guhitamo umurongo hakiri kare bigabanya guhindura imirongo mu buryo butunguranye. Kurikiza imyambi n'ibimenyetso bigaragaza aho buri murongo werekeza.

question: Iyo umurongo urimo ugenewe gusa ibinyabiziga bihindukira ibumoso, ukwiye gukora iki?
options: Kuwukoresha gusa niba icyerekezo cyawe gihuye n'icyo werekezamo
Kuwukoresha kugira ngo urenge umurongo w'imodoka
Kuwukoresha ugakomeza ugororotse nubwo imyambi ibibuza
Kuwukoresha kugira ngo uhagarare utegereje umugenzi
answer: Kuwukoresha gusa niba icyerekezo cyawe gihuye n'icyo werekezamo
explanation: Imyambi iri mu murongo igaragaza icyerekezo ibinyabiziga bigomba gukurikiza. Gukoresha umurongo utagenewe icyerekezo cyawe bishobora kubangamira abandi no guteza impanuka.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora igihe ageze ku masangano aho umukozi ubifitiye ububasha ari kuyobora urujya n'uruza?
options: Gukurikiza amabwiriza y'uwo mukozi no kugenzura umutekano mbere yo gukomeza
Gukurikiza itara gusa nubwo umukozi amutegeka ikindi
Kwirengagiza amabwiriza niba nta modoka ihari
Kugendera ku bimenyetso by'abandi bashoferi gusa
answer: Gukurikiza amabwiriza y'uwo mukozi no kugenzura umutekano mbere yo gukomeza
explanation: Umukozi ubifitiye ububasha ashobora kuyobora urujya n'uruza bitewe n'imiterere y'aho hantu. Witondere amabwiriza ye kandi wirinde gukomeza igihe bitari mu mutekano.

question: Iyo amatara yo ku masangano adakora, ni iyihe myitwarire ikwiye?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibyerekezo byose no gukurikiza ibindi bimenyetso cyangwa amabwiriza ahari
Kwemera ko ufite uburenganzira bwo kunyura mbere ya bose
Kunyura wihuta kugira ngo ugere hakurya
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibyerekezo byose no gukurikiza ibindi bimenyetso cyangwa amabwiriza ahari
explanation: Amatara adakora ashobora gutuma urujya n'uruza rudakurikiza gahunda isanzwe. Komeza witonze, wite ku bimenyetso bihari no ku bandi bakoresha umuhanda.

question: Iyo ibinyabiziga bibiri bigeze ku masangano icyarimwe kandi nta kimenyetso gihari, umushoferi agomba gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no gukurikiza itegeko ry'uburenganzira bwo kunyura rikurikizwa aho hantu
Kunyura mbere kubera ko yageze ahantu hihuta
Kuvuga ko imodoka nini ari yo ihora inyura mbere
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no gukurikiza itegeko ry'uburenganzira bwo kunyura rikurikizwa aho hantu
explanation: Uburenganzira bwo kunyura mu masangano bugengwa n'amategeko y'umuhanda n'imiterere y'amasangano. Ntukishingikirize ku bunini bw'imodoka cyangwa ku kwihuta; genzura inzira kandi witonde.

question: Iyo uri mu murongo w'ibinyabiziga kandi ushaka guhindura umurongo, ni iki ugomba kugenzura mbere?
options: Indorerwamo, ahatagaragara n'umwanya uhagije wo kwinjiramo
answer: Indorerwamo, ahatagaragara n'umwanya uhagije wo kwinjiramo
explanation: Indorerwamo ntizerekana buri kintu cyose kiri hafi y'imodoka. Kugenzura ahatagaragara no kureba ko hari umwanya bihashya ibyago byo kugongana mu gihe uhindura umurongo.

question: Iyo utwaye mu muhanda ufite imirongo igenewe ibinyabiziga bihindukira, ni ryari ugomba kwinjira mu murongo ujyanye n'icyerekezo cyawe?
options: Hakiri kare kandi igihe byemewe, utabangamiye abandi
Mu kanya ka nyuma uri hagati mu masangano
Nyuma yo kurenga umurongo wo guhagararaho
Igihe cyose nubwo umurongo udakwemerera kwinjiramo
answer: Hakiri kare kandi igihe byemewe, utabangamiye abandi
explanation: Kwinjira mu murongo ukwiye hakiri kare bituma abandi bamenya aho ugiye. Ntugahindure umurongo mu buryo butunguranye cyangwa ahatemewe.

question: Iyo umuhanda ufite ahantu hagenewe imodoka zitwara abantu benshi gusa, umushoferi w'imodoka isanzwe agomba gukora iki?
options: Kwirinda gukoresha iyo nzira keretse amategeko cyangwa ibimenyetso bibimwemerera
Kuyikoresha igihe cyose umurongo usanzwe urimo imodoka nyinshi
answer: Kwirinda gukoresha iyo nzira keretse amategeko cyangwa ibimenyetso bibimwemerera
explanation: Imirongo yihariye iba yagenewe ubwoko runaka bw'ibinyabiziga cyangwa ikoreshwa ryihariye. Kubahiriza icyo igenewe bituma urujya n'uruza rukomeza gukora neza.

question: Iyo ubonye ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko imbere hari ahantu ho kwambukira hakoreshejwe ikiraro cy'abanyamaguru, ni ikihe cyemezo cyiza ku munya­maguru?
options: Gukoresha ikiraro cyagenewe kwambuka igihe giteganyijwe kandi gishobora gukoreshwa
Kwambuka atarebye kuko ikiraro kiri hafi
answer: Gukoresha ikiraro cyagenewe kwambuka igihe giteganyijwe kandi gishobora gukoreshwa
explanation: Ikiraro cy'abanyamaguru gitandukanya abanyamaguru n'ibinyabiziga. Kugikoresha aho giteganyijwe bifasha kugabanya ibyago byo kugongwa.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora igihe abona ko umugenzi atarafunga neza umukandara w'umutekano?
options: Kumwibutsa kuwufunga neza mbere yo gutangira urugendo
Gutangira urugendo kuko umugenzi ari we ubazwa umutekano
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo urugendo rurangire vuba
answer: Kumwibutsa kuwufunga neza mbere yo gutangira urugendo
explanation: Abagenzi bagomba kwicara neza no gukoresha ibikoresho by'umutekano bibagenewe. Gukemura icyo kibazo mbere yo kugenda birinda kurangara no kugabanya ibyago byo gukomereka.

question: Iyo utwaye ikinyabiziga gifite umutwaro utwikira amatara cyangwa icyapa kiranga ikinyabiziga, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Kugena no gufunga umutwaro mu buryo butazitira ibikoresho by'umutekano cyangwa ibiranga ikinyabiziga
Kugenda uko biri kuko umutwaro ari muto
answer: Kugena no gufunga umutwaro mu buryo butazitira ibikoresho by'umutekano cyangwa ibiranga ikinyabiziga
explanation: Umutwaro ugomba gutwarwa mu buryo butabangamira kubona amatara, ibimenyetso cyangwa icyapa kiranga ikinyabiziga. Gutunganya umutwaro neza bifasha abandi bakoresha umuhanda kumenya ikinyabiziga no kugabanya ibyago.

question: Ni ikihe kibazo gishobora guterwa no gutwara umutwaro utaringaniye ku kinyabiziga?
options: Kugabanya uburinganire no gutuma kugenzura ikinyabiziga bigorana
Kongera ubushobozi bwa feri buri gihe
answer: Kugabanya uburinganire no gutuma kugenzura ikinyabiziga bigorana
explanation: Umutwaro utaringaniye ushobora guhindura uko ikinyabiziga cyitwara, cyane cyane mu guhindukira cyangwa gufata feri. Umutwaro ugomba kugabanywa no gufungwa neza hakurikijwe ubushobozi bw'ikinyabiziga.

question: Iyo utwaye ikinyabiziga gifite umutwaro ushobora kugwa cyangwa kuguruka, ni iki ugomba gukora mbere yo kugenda?
options: Kuwufunga no kugenzura ko ushobora gutwarwa utabangamiye abandi
Gusaba abagenzi kuwufata mu ntoki igihe cyose
Gufungura amadirishya kugira ngo umwuka winjire
answer: Kuwufunga no kugenzura ko ushobora gutwarwa utabangamiye abandi
explanation: Umutwaro utarinzwe ushobora kugwa mu muhanda cyangwa ugateza abandi ibibazo. Kugenzura uburyo ufungishijwe mbere y'urugendo birinda impanuka.

question: Iyo utwaye ikinyabiziga gifite romoruki, ni iki ugomba kwitondera cyane?
options: Uburebure bw'ikinyabiziga, intera yo guhagarara n'umwanya ukenewe mu guhindukira
answer: Uburebure bw'ikinyabiziga, intera yo guhagarara n'umwanya ukenewe mu guhindukira
explanation: Romoruki ihindura uburebure n'uburyo ikinyabiziga cyitwara. Umushoferi agomba guha umwanya uhagije guhindukira, guhagarara no kugenzura ko romoruki ihujwe neza n'ikinyabiziga kiyikurura.

question: Ni iki ukwiye gukora igihe utwaye ikinyabiziga kigenda gahoro kubera ikibazo cya tekiniki?
options: Kwirinda kubangamira abandi, kugenda ahatekanye no gushaka ubufasha bwo kugikoresha neza
Kuguma hagati mu muhanda utanga ibimenyetso
Guhatira abandi kugenda ku muvuduko wawe
answer: Kwirinda kubangamira abandi, kugenda ahatekanye no gushaka ubufasha bwo kugikoresha neza
explanation: Ikibazo cya tekiniki gishobora kugabanya ubushobozi bwo kugenda no kugenzura ikinyabiziga. Shaka ahantu hatekanye, uburire abandi igihe bikenewe kandi ntukomeze urugendo rudatekanye.

question: Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite itara ry'inyuma ritaka nabi, ni iki ukwiye gukora?
options: Kugikoresha mu buryo butekanye no kugisana vuba mbere yo gukomeza urugendo rudatekanye
Kwirengagiza ikibazo kuko amatara y'imbere akora
answer: Kugikoresha mu buryo butekanye no kugisana vuba mbere yo gukomeza urugendo rudatekanye
explanation: Amatara y'inyuma afasha abandi kumenya aho ikinyabiziga kiri n'ibikorwa byacyo, cyane cyane mu mwijima. Ibikoresho byangiritse bigomba gukosorwa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga gikomeze kuba mu mutekano.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora iyo abonye ko ikirahure cy'imbere kitakimwemerera kubona umuhanda neza?
options: Guhagarara ahatekanye no gukemura ikibazo mbere yo gukomeza
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo ave muri ako gace
Kureba mu idirishya gusa igihe cyose
answer: Guhagarara ahatekanye no gukemura ikibazo mbere yo gukomeza
explanation: Ikirahure cy'imbere gifasha umushoferi kubona umuhanda n'ibyago biri imbere. Iyo atakibona neza, agomba gukemura ikibazo ahatekanye kugira ngo atabangamira abandi cyangwa ngo ateze impanuka.

question: Iyo utwaye ikinyabiziga gifite indorerwamo yangiritse ku buryo utabona neza inyuma, ni iki ukwiye gukora?
options: Gukemura ikibazo no kwemeza ko ushobora gutwara mu mutekano mbere yo gukomeza
Kwegera ikinyabiziga kiri imbere kugira ngo ukibonereho
answer: Gukemura ikibazo no kwemeza ko ushobora gutwara mu mutekano mbere yo gukomeza
explanation: Indorerwamo zigufasha kumenya ibiri inyuma no ku mpande. Iyo zitagikora neza, kugenzura ibindi binyabiziga biragorana kandi ibyago byo kugongana biriyongera.

question: Ni ikihe gikorwa gifasha umushoferi gukoresha neza amatara y'ikinyabiziga mu ijoro?
options: Kugenzura ko amatara akora no guhitamo ayo gukoresha bitewe n'aho ari n'ibinyabiziga bihari
Gukoresha amatara maremare igihe cyose nubwo ahumye abandi
Kuzimya amatara igihe umuhanda ufite ibimenyetso
Gukoresha amatara yo kuburira mu mwanya w'amatara yose
answer: Kugenzura ko amatara akora no guhitamo ayo gukoresha bitewe n'aho ari n'ibinyabiziga bihari
explanation: Amatara agomba gufasha kubona no kugaragara atabangamiye abandi bashoferi. Hitamo amatara akwiye ukurikije uko umuhanda umeze n'amabwiriza abigenga.

question: Iyo utwaye imodoka ugasanga amatara y'ikinyabiziga giturutse imbere akuhumye, ni ikihe gikorwa gifasha kugumana umutekano?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba aho umuhanda ugaragara neza no kwirinda kureba amatara aturutse imbere
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo muhure vuba
Kugana hagati mu muhanda utabanje kugenzura
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba aho umuhanda ugaragara neza no kwirinda kureba amatara aturutse imbere
explanation: Amatara akomeye ashobora kugabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona by'agateganyo. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi ukomeze kugenzura aho unyura utavuye mu murongo wawe.

question: Iyo utwaye imodoka mu muhanda unyuramo ibinyabiziga biremereye, ni ikihe kintu cy'ingenzi ugomba kwitondera?
options: Kugumana intera ihagije no kwirinda kuguma ahatagaragara umushoferi w'ikinyabiziga kinini
Kugenda hafi y'inyuma y'ikamyo kugira ngo ubone umuhanda
Gutekereza ko ikinyabiziga kinini gihagarara vuba kurusha gito
answer: Kugumana intera ihagije no kwirinda kuguma ahatagaragara umushoferi w'ikinyabiziga kinini
explanation: Ibinyabiziga binini bishobora kugira ahantu henshi umushoferi atabona neza kandi bishobora gukenera umwanya munini wo guhagarara. Intera ihagije no kwirinda ahatagaragara bigabanya ibyago byo kugongana.

question: Ni ikihe kibazo gishobora guterwa no gutwara imodoka hafi cyane y'inyuma y'ikamyo?
options: Kutabona neza ibyago biri imbere no kubura intera yo kwitabara
answer: Kutabona neza ibyago biri imbere no kubura intera yo kwitabara
explanation: Kwegera cyane ikinyabiziga kinini bigabanya ibyo ubona imbere kandi bikagabanya igihe cyo kwitabara. Komeza intera ihagije kugira ngo ubone umuhanda kandi ubashe guhagarara mu mutekano.

question: Iyo ugiye kunyura ku kinyabiziga kinini, ni iki ugomba kubanza kugenzura?
options: Ko kunyura byemewe, inzira ifunguye kandi ushobora kurangiza igikorwa mu mutekano
Ko ikinyabiziga kinini gifite ibara ryiza
Ko ushobora kuguma mu murongo utarebye imbere
Ko ushobora kunyura nubwo ikimenyetso kibibuza
answer: Ko kunyura byemewe, inzira ifunguye kandi ushobora kurangiza igikorwa mu mutekano
explanation: Kunyura ku kinyabiziga kinini bishobora gufata umwanya munini kandi bigasaba kureba intera ihagije. Ntutangire kunyura niba utabona neza imbere cyangwa niba amategeko abibuza.

question: Iyo utwaye mu muhanda urimo ibinogo byinshi, ni ikihe cyemezo gifasha kurinda umutekano?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no guhitamo inzira ishoboka mu mutekano utabangamiye abandi
Kugenda wihuta kugira ngo imodoka itanyeganyega
Gukoresha umurongo w'ibinyabiziga bihanganye igihe cyose
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no guhitamo inzira ishoboka mu mutekano utabangamiye abandi
explanation: Ibinogo bishobora kwangiza amapine cyangwa gutuma ikinyabiziga gitakaza uburinganire. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi ntukore igikorwa gitunguranye gishobora gushyira abandi mu kaga.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora igihe umukungugu mwinshi uturutse ku modoka iri imbere ugabanya uko abona umuhanda?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kongera intera kugeza abonye neza
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kongera intera kugeza abonye neza
explanation: Umukungugu ugabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona ibiri imbere n'ibiri ku mpande. Kugabanya umuvuduko no kongera intera biguha umwanya wo kwitabara mu gihe hagize ikintu kigaragara gitunguranye.

question: Iyo amazi yarenze ku muhanda ku buryo utazi ubujyakuzimu bwayo, ni ikihe cyemezo cyiza?
options: Kwirinda kwinjiramo kugeza umenye ko kunyuramo ari umutekano
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo usohoke vuba
Gukurikira imodoka iri imbere utitaye ku bujyakuzimu
Guhagarara hagati mu mazi kugira ngo urebe moteri
answer: Kwirinda kwinjiramo kugeza umenye ko kunyuramo ari umutekano
explanation: Amazi ashobora kuba maremare kurusha uko agaragara cyangwa akaba afite umuvuduko ukomeye. Ntukinjire ahantu hatagaragara neza cyangwa hashobora gutuma ikinyabiziga gitakaza ubushobozi bwo kugenzurwa.

question: Iyo utwaye imodoka ugasanga hari amabuye cyangwa ibindi bintu byaguye mu muhanda, ukwiye gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no guhitamo igikorwa cyizewe nyuma yo kugenzura ibindi binyabiziga
Kunyura mu murongo uhanganye n'ibindi binyabiziga
Gufata feri gitunguranye utitaye ku bakuri inyuma
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no guhitamo igikorwa cyizewe nyuma yo kugenzura ibindi binyabiziga
explanation: Inzitizi zishobora gutuma ugomba guhindura icyerekezo cyangwa guhagarara. Reba ibiri inyuma no ku mpande, gabanya umuvuduko kandi uhitemo uburyo butabangamira abandi.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora igihe abona ko imodoka iri inyuma imukurikiye hafi cyane?
options: Kugumana umuvuduko utekanye, kwirinda gufata feri gitunguranye no guha umwanya uwo mushoferi kunyura igihe byemewe
Gufata feri gitunguranye kugira ngo amwigishe
answer: Kugumana umuvuduko utekanye, kwirinda gufata feri gitunguranye no guha umwanya uwo mushoferi kunyura igihe byemewe
explanation: Guhangana n'umushoferi ugukurikiye hafi bishobora guteza impanuka. Komeza utuje, wirinde ibikorwa bitunguranye kandi umuhe amahirwe yo kunyura mu buryo bwemewe igihe bishoboka.

question: Iyo uri gutwara imodoka ugasanga urumuri rw'izuba rukubuza kubona neza, ni iki ukwiye gukora?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko, gukoresha ibikoresho bikwiye byo kurinda amaso no kongera kwitonda
Gukomeza ku muvuduko umwe utitaye ku byo ubona
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko, gukoresha ibikoresho bikwiye byo kurinda amaso no kongera kwitonda
explanation: Urumuri rukaze rushobora kugabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona ibimenyetso n'ibyago. Gabanya umuvuduko kandi ukoreshe uburyo bwemewe bwo kurinda amaso utabangamiye kubona umuhanda.

question: Ni iki ukwiye gukora igihe ubonye ikimenyetso cy'igihe gito kiyobora ibinyabiziga mu gihe cy'ibirori cyangwa igikorwa rusange?
options: Gukurikiza icyerekezo cy'agateganyo no kwitegereza abashinzwe kuyobora urujya n'uruza
Kugikurikiza gusa igihe hari imodoka nyinshi
Kunyura ahafunzwe niba uri mu rugendo rwihutirwa rutari ubutabazi
answer: Gukurikiza icyerekezo cy'agateganyo no kwitegereza abashinzwe kuyobora urujya n'uruza
explanation: Ibimenyetso by'agateganyo bishyirwaho kugira ngo umutekano n'uruhererekane rw'ibinyabiziga birindwe mu bihe byihariye. Kubahiriza ibyo bimenyetso bifasha kwirinda urujijo no kugongana.

question: 101. Iyo ugeze ku itara ritukura ryo mu muhanda, ugomba gukora iki?
answer: Guhagarara mbere y'umurongo wabigenewe
explanation: Itara ritukura risaba guhagarara. Gukomeza utabiherewe uburenganzira bishobora guteza impanuka kandi bikaba binyuranyije n'amategeko.

question: 102. Itara ry'umuhondo rimaze kwaka risobanura iki?
options: Kwitegura guhagarara niba bishoboka mu mutekano
answer: Kwitegura guhagarara niba bishoboka mu mutekano
explanation: Itara ry'umuhondo riburira umushoferi ko icyiciro cy'amatara kiri guhinduka. Agomba guhagarara niba yabikora atateje ibyago.

question: 103. Iyo ugeze ku itara ry'icyatsi, ni iki ugomba kubanza kureba?
options: Ko inzira imbere itekanye kandi nta wundi uri mu muhanda
Ko imodoka iri imbere ari nshya
answer: Ko inzira imbere itekanye kandi nta wundi uri mu muhanda
explanation: Itara ry'icyatsi ritanga uburenganzira bwo gukomeza ariko ntirukuraho inshingano yo kureba niba inzira itekanye.

question: 104. Umurongo ukomeje hagati y'imirongo y'imodoka usanzwe usobanura iki?
options: Ko kuwurenga cyangwa kuwambuka bibujijwe keretse aho amategeko abyemera
answer: Ko kuwurenga cyangwa kuwambuka bibujijwe keretse aho amategeko abyemera
explanation: Umurongo ukomeje ugabanya ahantu hatagomba kurengwa mu buryo busanzwe. Itegeko nyaryo riterwa n'ibimenyetso n'amabwiriza y'aho uri.

question: 105. Kuki ugomba kugenzura indorerwamo mbere yo guhindura umurongo?
options: Kugira ngo umenye ibinyabiziga biri inyuma cyangwa iruhande rwawe
answer: Kugira ngo umenye ibinyabiziga biri inyuma cyangwa iruhande rwawe
explanation: Indorerwamo zigufasha kumenya ibiri hafi yawe. Ugomba no kugenzura aho indorerwamo zitagaragaza mbere yo kwimuka.

question: 106. Ni ryari ugomba gukoresha itara ry'ikimenyetso cyo guhindukira?
options: Mbere yo guhindukira cyangwa guhindura umurongo
answer: Mbere yo guhindukira cyangwa guhindura umurongo
explanation: Gutanga ikimenyetso hakiri kare biburira abandi icyo ugiye gukora, bikabaha umwanya wo kwitwararika.

question: 107. Iyo ugeze ku cyapa gisaba guhagarara burundu, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Guhagarara burundu no kureba ko inzira itekanye
answer: Guhagarara burundu no kureba ko inzira itekanye
explanation: Icyapa cyo guhagarara gisaba guhagarara burundu, hanyuma ukareba abandi bakoresha umuhanda mbere yo gukomeza.

question: 108. Kuki kugendera hafi cyane y'imodoka ikuri imbere ari bibi?
options: Bigabanya igihe n'umwanya byo kwirinda kugongana
answer: Bigabanya igihe n'umwanya byo kwirinda kugongana
explanation: Intera ihagije iguha umwanya wo gufata feri igihe imodoka iri imbere ihagaze cyangwa igabanyije umuvuduko gitunguranye.

question: 109. Iyo umuhanda unyerera kubera imvura, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kongera intera hagati y'imodoka
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kongera intera hagati y'imodoka
explanation: Amazi agabanya gufata neza kw'amapine ku muhanda. Umuvuduko muke n'intera ndende bifasha kwirinda kunyerera no kugongana.

question: 110. Ni iki cy'ingenzi mbere yo kurenga indi modoka?
options: Kureba ko inzira imbere n'inyuma itekanye kandi kurenga byemewe
answer: Kureba ko inzira imbere n'inyuma itekanye kandi kurenga byemewe
explanation: Kurenga bisaba kubona intera ihagije, gutanga ikimenyetso no kugenzura ko nta kindi kinyabiziga kiri kugutera ibyago.

question: 111. Iyo wumva imodoka y'ubutabazi ifite sirene n'amatara y'ubutabazi, wakora iki?
options: Kuyihesha inzira mu buryo butekanye kandi bukurikiza amategeko
Guhagarara hagati mu masangano utabanje kureba
answer: Kuyihesha inzira mu buryo butekanye kandi bukurikiza amategeko
explanation: Imodoka z'ubutabazi zishobora kuba zigiye gutabara. Abandi bakoresha umuhanda bagomba kuzorohereza kunyura ariko ntibateze impanuka.

question: 112. Kuki umushoferi agomba kwirinda gukoresha telefoni mu gihe atwaye?
options: Kuko imurangaza kandi ikagabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona ibyago
answer: Kuko imurangaza kandi ikagabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona ibyago
explanation: Kureba telefoni cyangwa kuyandikaho ubutumwa bikura amaso n'ibitekerezo ku muhanda. Ibi bitinza gufata icyemezo no gufata feri.

question: 113. Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora igihe yumva ananiwe cyane?
options: Gufungura idirishya agakomeza uko byagenda kose
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo agere vuba
answer: Guhagarara ahatekanye akaruhuka
explanation: Umunaniro ugabanya ubushishozi n'ubushobozi bwo kwihutira kwirinda ibyago. Kuruhuka ni ingenzi kuruta gukomeza utameze neza.

question: 114. Iyo wegereye ishuri riri hafi y'umuhanda, ugomba kwitwararika iki?
answer: Abanyeshuri bashobora kwambuka gitunguranye
explanation: Ahari ishuri hashobora kuba abana bambuka cyangwa bagenda hafi y'umuhanda. Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guhagarara birinda impanuka.

question: 115. Ni gute ugomba kwegera umuhanda urimo umurongo w'abanyamaguru?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no guha abanyamaguru uburenganzira igihe amategeko abiteganya
Kuvuza ihoni kugira ngo bose bahunge
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no guha abanyamaguru uburenganzira igihe amategeko abiteganya
explanation: Ahambukira abanyamaguru hasaba ubushishozi. Umushoferi agomba kubahiriza ibyapa n'amategeko no kwirinda gushyira abanyamaguru mu kaga.

question: 116. Ni iyihe mpamvu yo kwambara umukandara w'umutekano?
options: Kugira ngo umuntu yicare neza gusa
Kugabanya ibyago byo gukomereka igihe habaye impanuka
answer: Kugabanya ibyago byo gukomereka igihe habaye impanuka
explanation: Umukandara ufasha gufata umubiri mu mwanya wabugenewe igihe imodoka ihagaze gitunguranye cyangwa igonganye.

question: 117. Ni ikihe kibazo gishobora guterwa n'amapine atagifite imiterere myiza yo gufata umuhanda?
options: Kongera ibyago byo kunyerera no gutakaza ubushobozi bwo kuyobora
answer: Kongera ibyago byo kunyerera no gutakaza ubushobozi bwo kuyobora
explanation: Amapine yangiritse cyangwa ashaje ashobora kutafata umuhanda neza, cyane cyane igihe hari amazi cyangwa umuhanda unyerera.

question: 118. Kuki amatara y'imodoka agomba kugenzurwa buri gihe?
options: Kugira ngo imodoka isa n'iyiza gusa
Kugira ngo ubone kandi ugaragare ku bandi bakoresha umuhanda
answer: Kugira ngo ubone kandi ugaragare ku bandi bakoresha umuhanda
explanation: Amatara akora neza afasha kubona inzira no gutuma abandi bakubona, cyane cyane nijoro cyangwa mu bihe bitabona neza.

question: 119. Iyo ubonye icyapa kiburira umuhanda unyerera, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwirinda ibikorwa bitunguranye
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwirinda ibikorwa bitunguranye
explanation: Kuyobora cyangwa gufata feri mu buryo bukaze bishobora gutuma imodoka inyerera. Koresha ibikorwa byoroheje kandi ugenzure umuvuduko.

question: 120. Iyo ugiye gusubiza imodoka inyuma, ni ikihe gikorwa cy'umutekano?
options: Kugenzura inyuma no ku mpande zose no kugenda buhoro
answer: Kugenzura inyuma no ku mpande zose no kugenda buhoro
explanation: Abantu, abana cyangwa ibintu bishobora kuba ahantu indorerwamo zitagaragaza. Kugenda buhoro no kugenzura impande zose bigabanya ibyago.

question: 121. Ni ryari ugomba gucana amatara igihe utwaye?
options: Igihe amategeko abiteganya, harimo nijoro no mu bihe bitabona neza
answer: Igihe amategeko abiteganya, harimo nijoro no mu bihe bitabona neza
explanation: Amatara afasha kubona no kugaragara. Ugomba kubahiriza amabwiriza agenga igihe n'uburyo amatara akoreshwa.

question: 122. Ni iki ugomba gukora igihe ugeze mu masangano udafite amatara cyangwa ibyapa bigena uwabanza?
options: Kwihuta kugira ngo ube uwa mbere
Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba impande zose no gukurikiza itegeko ry'uburenganzira bwo kunyura
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba impande zose no gukurikiza itegeko ry'uburenganzira bwo kunyura
explanation: Mu masangano adafite igenzura, ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gukurikiza amategeko agena uburenganzira bwo kunyura. Ntukibwire ko abandi baguhaye inzira.

question: 123. Kuki guhindura umurongo utatanze ikimenyetso ari bibi?
options: Abandi ntibamenya icyo ugiye gukora kandi bashobora kugongana nawe
answer: Abandi ntibamenya icyo ugiye gukora kandi bashobora kugongana nawe
explanation: Ikimenyetso gituma abandi bateganya uko bagomba kwitwara. Kugihisha cyangwa kukitanga utinze bishobora guteza impanuka.

question: 124. Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora mbere yo gutangira urugendo rurerure?
options: Kugenzura uko imodoka imeze n'ibikoresho by'ingenzi
answer: Kugenzura uko imodoka imeze n'ibikoresho by'ingenzi
explanation: Kugenzura amapine, feri, amatara n'ibindi bikoresho by'umutekano mbere y'urugendo bishobora gutahura ikibazo hakiri kare.

question: 125. Iyo feri z'imodoka zitangiye gukora nabi, ni iki cy'ingenzi?
options: Guhagarara ahatekanye no gusaba ubufasha bwo gusana
answer: Guhagarara ahatekanye no gusaba ubufasha bwo gusana
explanation: Feri ni kimwe mu bikoresho by'ingenzi by'umutekano. Gukomeza gutwara imodoka ifite feri zitizewe bishobora guteza impanuka ikomeye.

question: 126. Kuki kugendera ku muvuduko urenze uwemewe ari bibi?
options: Bituma umuntu abona ibyago hakiri kare
Byongera intera yo guhagarara kandi bikongera ubukana bw'impanuka
answer: Byongera intera yo guhagarara kandi bikongera ubukana bw'impanuka
explanation: Iyo umuvuduko wiyongereye, imodoka ikenera umwanya munini kugira ngo ihagarare. Impanuka ibaye ishobora no kugira ingaruka zikomeye kurushaho.

question: 127. Ni iki ugomba gukora igihe wegereye ikamyo nini iri guhindukira?
options: Kuyiha umwanya no kutinjira ahantu ishobora kutakubona
answer: Kuyiha umwanya no kutinjira ahantu ishobora kutakubona
explanation: Amakamyo manini agira ahantu umushoferi atabasha kubona neza. Kuyiha umwanya birinda kugongwa igihe ihindukira.

question: 128. Ni iyihe mpamvu yo kwirinda gutwara imodoka uri kurakara cyane cyangwa uhangayitse bikabije?
options: Bishobora kugabanya ubushishozi no gutuma ufata ibyemezo bibi
answer: Bishobora kugabanya ubushishozi no gutuma ufata ibyemezo bibi
explanation: Imiterere y'amarangamutima ishobora kugira ingaruka ku kwibanda no ku gucunga umuvuduko. Ni byiza gutuza mbere yo gutwara.

question: 129. Iyo igihu gitumye utabona kure, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Gukoresha amatara akwiye no kugabanya umuvuduko
Gukurikira imodoka iri imbere hafi cyane
answer: Gukoresha amatara akwiye no kugabanya umuvuduko
explanation: Igihu kigabanya kureba. Amatara akwiye, umuvuduko muke n'intera ihagije bifasha kwirinda impanuka.

question: 130. Ni ikihe gikorwa gikwiye igihe ugeze ku kayira k'abanyamaguru cyangwa ahanyura abanyamaguru?
options: Kureba niba hari abanyamaguru no kubaha inzira hakurikijwe amategeko
Kuhahagarara igihe cyose nubwo byateza ibyago
answer: Kureba niba hari abanyamaguru no kubaha inzira hakurikijwe amategeko
explanation: Abanyamaguru ntibafite uburinzi nk'ubw'abari mu modoka. Umushoferi agomba kwitwararika no kubahiriza amategeko agenga kwambuka.

question: 131. Kuki gutwara imodoka nyuma yo kunywa inzoga bishobora guteza impanuka?
options: Zigabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona ibyago, gufata ibyemezo no kugenzura imodoka
answer: Zigabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona ibyago, gufata ibyemezo no kugenzura imodoka
explanation: Inzoga zigira ingaruka ku bwonko no ku mikorere y'umubiri. Inzira yizewe ni ukutiyobora nyuma yo kunywa inzoga.

question: 132. Iyo utwaye igare ku muhanda, ni iki kigufasha kurinda umutekano wawe?
options: Kubahiriza amategeko, kugaragaza ibyo ugiye gukora no gukoresha ibikoresho bigaragara
answer: Kubahiriza amategeko, kugaragaza ibyo ugiye gukora no gukoresha ibikoresho bigaragara
explanation: Abatwara amagare na bo bagomba kwitwara mu buryo buteganyijwe n'amategeko. Kugaragara no gutanga ibimenyetso bifasha abandi kubabona.

question: 133. Kuki umugenzi uri kuri moto agomba kwambara ingofero yabugenewe?
options: Kugabanya ibyago byo gukomereka mu mutwe
answer: Kugabanya ibyago byo gukomereka mu mutwe
explanation: Ingofero yabugenewe ifasha kurinda umutwe igihe habaye impanuka. Igomba kwambarwa neza kandi igakurikiza ibisabwa n'amategeko.

question: 134. Ni iki umugenzi uri kuri moto agomba gukora kugira ngo arusheho kugira umutekano?
options: Kwicara neza no gukurikiza amabwiriza y'umutekano
answer: Kwicara neza no gukurikiza amabwiriza y'umutekano
explanation: Umugenzi agomba kwicara mu mwanya wabugenewe, kwambara ibikoresho by'umutekano no kutagira ibikorwa bishobora kurangaza umushoferi.

question: 135. Iyo imodoka yawe ipfiriye mu muhanda, ni iki ugomba gushyira imbere?
options: Kuyisiga hagati mu muhanda nta kimenyetso
Kuyishyira ahatekanye niba bishoboka no kuburira abandi mu buryo bwemewe
answer: Kuyishyira ahatekanye niba bishoboka no kuburira abandi mu buryo bwemewe
explanation: Imodoka yangiritse ishobora kuba imbogamizi. Kuyishyira ahatekanye no gukoresha ibimenyetso byo kuburira abandi bigabanya ibyago.

question: 136. Kuki ugomba kubahiriza amabwiriza y'umupolisi uyobora umuhanda?
options: Kuko amabwiriza ye agenga uko abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kunyura
Kuko amabwiriza ye areba abanyamaguru gusa
answer: Kuko amabwiriza ye agenga uko abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kunyura
explanation: Umupolisi uyobora umuhanda ashobora kugena uko abantu n'ibinyabiziga bigenda. Ugomba gukurikiza amabwiriza ye no kwitwararika.

question: 137. Ni iki ugomba gukora igihe ugeze ku cyapa kiburira ko imbere hari umuhanda w'amateme cyangwa umanuka cyane?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guhindura uburyo utwara
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guhindura uburyo utwara
explanation: Imiterere y'umuhanda ishobora kongera ibyago byo kunyerera cyangwa gutakaza ubushobozi bwo kugenzura imodoka. Umuvuduko ugomba kujyana n'imiterere y'inzira.

question: 138. Kuki bidakwiye gupakira ibintu birenze ubushobozi bw'imodoka?
options: Bishobora kugira ingaruka ku kugenzura imodoka, feri no kuringaniza uburemere
answer: Bishobora kugira ingaruka ku kugenzura imodoka, feri no kuringaniza uburemere
explanation: Umutwaro urenze urugero ushobora gutuma imodoka itagendera neza, ikananirwa guhagarara neza cyangwa igahungabana.

question: 139. Ni iki ugomba gukora igihe utwaye imodoka kandi umwana ari hafi y'umuhanda?
options: Kunyura vuba mbere y'uko umwana akubona
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guhagarara
explanation: Abana bashobora kwinjira mu muhanda batabanje kureba. Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guhagarara ni ingenzi cyane.

question: 140. Ni iyihe mpamvu yo kutajugunya imyanda mu muhanda utwaye?
options: Ishobora kubangamira abandi no kwangiza ibidukikije
answer: Ishobora kubangamira abandi no kwangiza ibidukikije
explanation: Imyanda ishobora guteza ibyago ku binyabiziga no ku banyamaguru, ndetse ikangiza ibidukikije. Abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kuwusigasira.

question: 141. Ni ikihe gikorwa cyiza igihe ugiye guhagarika imodoka ku ruhande rw'umuhanda?
options: Kureba ko aho ugiye guhagarara hemewe kandi hatabangamira abandi
answer: Kureba ko aho ugiye guhagarara hemewe kandi hatabangamira abandi
explanation: Guhagarara ahatemewe bishobora kubangamira ibinyabiziga n'abanyamaguru cyangwa kugabanya uko abandi babona inzira.

question: 142. Kuki udakwiye guhagarara aho utabona neza umuhanda uhuriramo n'undi?
options: Kuko bishobora kubangamira abandi no gutuma impanuka iba
answer: Kuko bishobora kubangamira abandi no gutuma impanuka iba
explanation: Ahantu hatabona neza cyangwa amasangano bisaba ko umushoferi agumana ubushobozi bwo kureba no kwirinda ibyago. Hagarara gusa ahantu hemewe kandi hatekanye.

question: 143. Ni iki ugomba gukora igihe ubonye imodoka iri imbere yawe itangiye kugabanya umuvuduko?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kugumana intera ihagije
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kugumana intera ihagije
explanation: Imodoka ishobora kuba igiye guhagarara kubera umunyamaguru, ikintu mu muhanda cyangwa ikibazo. Intera ihagije iguha umwanya wo kwitabara.

question: 144. Kuki amatara maremare atagomba gukoreshwa mu buryo buhuma abandi bashoferi?
options: Kuko ashobora kubabuza kubona neza umuhanda
answer: Kuko ashobora kubabuza kubona neza umuhanda
explanation: Amatara ahumye ashobora gutuma undi mushoferi atabona neza inzira. Koresha amatara akwiye ukurikije uko umuhanda umeze n'amategeko.

question: 145. Iyo ugeze ku cyapa cyerekana ko imbere hari umuhanda uca ku murongo wa gari ya moshi, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Kwihuta ngo wambuke mbere ya gari ya moshi
Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibimenyetso no guhagarara igihe bisabwa
Guhagarara ku murongo wa gari ya moshi
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibimenyetso no guhagarara igihe bisabwa
explanation: Gari ya moshi ntishobora guhagarara vuba. Ugomba kubahiriza inzitizi, amatara n'ibimenyetso kandi ntuhagarare ku murongo wayo.

question: 146. Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora igihe atwaye hafi y'abanyamaguru n'abatwaye amagare?
options: Kugumana umwanya uhagije no kwirinda kubashyira mu kaga
answer: Kugumana umwanya uhagije no kwirinda kubashyira mu kaga
explanation: Abanyamaguru n'abatwaye amagare ntibakingiwe nk'abari mu modoka. Umushoferi agomba kubaha umwanya n'umutekano ukwiye.

question: 147. Ni iki ugomba gukora igihe imodoka itangiye kunyerera?
options: Gukata ikoni no gufata feri bikaze
Kwirinda ibikorwa bikaze no kugerageza kugarura icyerekezo mu buryo butuje
answer: Kwirinda ibikorwa bikaze no kugerageza kugarura icyerekezo mu buryo butuje
explanation: Ibikorwa bikaze bishobora kongera kunyerera. Gumana umutuzo, wirinde gukata bikabije kandi ukurikize amahugurwa y'umutekano ajyanye n'imiterere y'imodoka.

question: 148. Ni iyihe mpamvu yo kubahiriza icyerekezo cyerekanwa n'ibyapa ku muhanda umwe?
options: Kugira ngo ibinyabiziga bigende mu cyerekezo cyateganyijwe kandi birinde kugongana
Kugira ngo umushoferi ahitemo icyerekezo icyo ari cyo cyose
answer: Kugira ngo ibinyabiziga bigende mu cyerekezo cyateganyijwe kandi birinde kugongana
explanation: Umuhanda w'icyerekezo kimwe uba uteganyijwe kugira ngo ibinyabiziga bitazahurira mu byerekezo binyuranye. Gukurikiza ibyapa birinda impanuka.

question: 149. Ni iki ugomba gukora igihe ubonye icyapa kigaragaza ko umuvuduko ntarengwa wagabanutse?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko ukurikije umuvuduko mushya wemewe
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko ukurikije umuvuduko mushya wemewe
explanation: Icyapa cy'umuvuduko ntarengwa kigaragaza umuvuduko udakwiye kurengwa. Kugabanya umuvuduko bituma ujyana n'imiterere y'ahantu.

question: 150. Ni iyihe myitwarire iranga umushoferi ufite umutekano?
options: Kwibwira ko abandi bose bagomba kumuharira inzira
Kubahiriza amategeko, kwitwararika no kwita ku bandi bakoresha umuhanda
Kwirengagiza ibyapa iyo umuhanda usa n'utuje
answer: Kubahiriza amategeko, kwitwararika no kwita ku bandi bakoresha umuhanda
explanation: Gutwara neza bisaba kubahiriza amategeko, kwitegura ibyago, kwirinda kurangara no kubaha umutekano w'abandi bose bakoresha umuhanda.

question: Kuki umushoferi agomba kugenzura indorerwamo mbere yo guhindura icyerekezo?
options: Kugira ngo arebe niba nta kinyabiziga cyangwa undi ukoresha umuhanda uri hafi
Kugira ngo arebe niba imodoka ye isukuye
answer: Kugira ngo arebe niba nta kinyabiziga cyangwa undi ukoresha umuhanda uri hafi
explanation: Kugenzura indorerwamo bifasha umushoferi kumenya ibiri inyuma no ku mpande z'imodoka. Agomba no kureba ahantu indorerwamo zitagaragaza mbere yo kwimuka.

question: Iyo umuhanda unyerera kubera imvura, umushoferi akwiriye gukora iki?
options: Gufata feri mu buryo butunguranye buri gihe
Kugabanya umuvuduko no kongera intera hagati y'ibinyabiziga
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kongera intera hagati y'ibinyabiziga
explanation: Amazi ashobora kugabanya ubushobozi bw'amapine bwo gufata umuhanda. Umuvuduko muke n'intera nini bitanga igihe n'umwanya bihagije byo guhagarara.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora mbere yo gusubiza imodoka inyuma?
options: Kugenzura ko inyuma hari umutekano no gusubiza inyuma buhoro
answer: Kugenzura ko inyuma hari umutekano no gusubiza inyuma buhoro
explanation: Abanyamaguru, abana n'ibindi bintu bishobora kuba inyuma y'imodoka bitagaragara neza. Umushoferi agomba kugenzura neza kandi agahagarara igihe atizeye ko inzira itekanye.

question: Iyo ubonye ikinyabiziga cy'abatabazi gifite amatara n'ibimenyetso byihutirwa, wakora iki?
options: Kugifasha kunyura mu buryo butekanye kandi ukurikiza amategeko
answer: Kugifasha kunyura mu buryo butekanye kandi ukurikiza amategeko
explanation: Ikinyabiziga cy'abatabazi gishobora kuba kijya gufasha umuntu uri mu kaga. Umushoferi agomba gutanga inzira mu buryo butateza impanuka cyangwa ngo arenge ku mategeko.

question: Ni iki gishobora guterwa no gukoresha terefone mu ntoki utwaye?
options: Kugabanya ubushobozi bwo kwitondera umuhanda no gutinda gufata icyemezo
answer: Kugabanya ubushobozi bwo kwitondera umuhanda no gutinda gufata icyemezo
explanation: Kuvugira kuri terefone cyangwa kwandika ubutumwa bikura ibitekerezo ku muhanda. Ibi byongera ibyago byo kutabona ibimenyetso, abanyamaguru cyangwa ibinyabiziga biri imbere.

question: Kuki ugomba kugenzura amapine mbere y'urugendo rurerure?
options: Kugira ngo wongere urusaku rwa moteri
Kugira ngo umenye ko afite umwuka ukwiye kandi atangiritse
answer: Kugira ngo umenye ko afite umwuka ukwiye kandi atangiritse
explanation: Amapine ameze neza kandi afite umwuka ukwiye afasha imodoka gufata umuhanda no kugenzurwa neza. Amapine yangiritse ashobora gutera impanuka.

question: Iyo ubonye ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari ishuri, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura abana bashobora kwambuka
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo uhite uhava
Kunyura ku zindi modoka utitaye ku nzira
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura abana bashobora kwambuka
explanation: Abana bashobora kwambuka batabanje kubona ikinyabiziga. Kugabanya umuvuduko no kureba impande z'umuhanda bifasha kwirinda impanuka.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora iyo imodoka itangiye kunyerera?
options: Kugabanya ibikorwa bikarishye kuri volante na feri no kugenzura imodoka buhoro
answer: Kugabanya ibikorwa bikarishye kuri volante na feri no kugenzura imodoka buhoro
explanation: Gukata volante cyangwa gufata feri mu buryo bukarishye bishobora kongera kunyerera. Umushoferi agomba gutuza, kugabanya umuvuduko buhoro no kugenzura imodoka uko bishoboka.

question: Kuki ari ngombwa gukoresha itara ryerekana icyerekezo mbere yo gukata?
options: Kugira ngo abandi bakoresha umuhanda bamenye icyo uteganya gukora
answer: Kugira ngo abandi bakoresha umuhanda bamenye icyo uteganya gukora
explanation: Itara ry'icyerekezo riburira abandi ko ugiye gukata cyangwa guhindura umurongo. Rigomba gukoreshwa mbere y'igikorwa kandi ukabanza kureba ko ari umutekano.

question: Iyo ugeze ku murongo wambukiranya umuhanda wa gari ya moshi kandi inzitizi zikaba ziri kumanuka, wakora iki?
options: Guhagarara ahatekanye mbere y'umurongo no gutegereza
Guhagarara hagati ya gari ya moshi n'inzitizi
answer: Guhagarara ahatekanye mbere y'umurongo no gutegereza
explanation: Gari ya moshi ntishobora guhagarara vuba nk'imodoka. Ntugomba kunyura ku nzitizi ziri kumanuka cyangwa kwinjira ku murongo igihe kunyuraho bitizewe.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora iyo abonye ikimenyetso cyo kugabanya umuvuduko?
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko hakurikijwe amabwiriza y'ikimenyetso
explanation: Ibimenyetso by'umuhanda bitanga amabwiriza agomba gukurikizwa. Umuvuduko ugomba kuba ukurikije ikimenyetso n'imiterere y'umuhanda.

question: Kuki umushoferi agomba kugenzura feri z'imodoka buri gihe?
options: Kugira ngo imodoka ikoreshe lisansi nyinshi
Kugira ngo imodoka igende nta mapine
Kugira ngo amenye ko ishobora kugabanya umuvuduko no guhagarara neza
answer: Kugira ngo amenye ko ishobora kugabanya umuvuduko no guhagarara neza
explanation: Feri zidakora neza zongera ibyago byo kugonga ikinyabiziga cyangwa umuntu. Iyo ubonye ikibazo kuri feri, ntukomeze urugendo nk'aho imodoka imeze neza.

question: Iyo ubonye umunyamaguru atangiye kwambuka ahagenewe kwambukira, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kumuha inzira nk'uko amategeko abiteganya
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo umunyamaguru ategereze
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kumuha inzira nk'uko amategeko abiteganya
explanation: Ahagenewe kwambukira abanyamaguru ni ahantu hakenera ubwitonzi. Umushoferi agomba gukurikiza amategeko yo gutanga inzira no kwirinda gushyira umunyamaguru mu kaga.

question: Ni iki gituma intera yo guhagarara yiyongera?
options: Umuvuduko mwinshi, umuhanda unyerera cyangwa feri zitameze neza
answer: Umuvuduko mwinshi, umuhanda unyerera cyangwa feri zitameze neza
explanation: Umuvuduko mwinshi wongera intera imodoka ikenera kugira ngo ihagarare. Umuhanda unyerera n'ibibazo bya feri na byo bishobora gutuma guhagarara bigorana.

question: Iyo ugiye kunyura ku kindi kinyabiziga, ni iki ugomba kubanza kugenzura?
options: Ko umuhanda imbere ufunguye, ko nta kimenyetso kibibuza kandi ko kunyura ari umutekano
Ko ushobora kwihuta utitaye ku bandi
answer: Ko umuhanda imbere ufunguye, ko nta kimenyetso kibibuza kandi ko kunyura ari umutekano
explanation: Kunyura ku kindi kinyabiziga bisaba kubona neza imbere, kugira umwanya uhagije no kubahiriza ibimenyetso. Ntugomba kunyura aho bishobora guteza impanuka.

question: Kuki umushoferi atagomba gutwara imodoka ananiwe cyane?
options: Kuko umunaniro ushobora kugabanya ubwitonzi no gutinza uko yitwara ku kaga
answer: Kuko umunaniro ushobora kugabanya ubwitonzi no gutinza uko yitwara ku kaga
explanation: Umunaniro ugabanya ubushobozi bwo kwibanda no gufata ibyemezo. Umushoferi wumva ananiwe agomba guhagarara ahatekanye akaruhuka mbere yo gukomeza.

question: Iyo ubonye ikimenyetso kibuza kunyura ku kindi kinyabiziga, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Kunyura gusa iyo uri mu bwihisho
Kugikurikiza no kuguma inyuma y'ikinyabiziga kugeza kunyura byemewe
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo urangize vuba
answer: Kugikurikiza no kuguma inyuma y'ikinyabiziga kugeza kunyura byemewe
explanation: Ikimenyetso kibuzanya kunyura gishyirwaho ahantu icyo gikorwa gishobora guteza akaga. Tegereza ahantu kunyura byemewe kandi bitekanye.

question: Ni iki ugomba gukora iyo ubonye ikimenyetso cy'umuhanda kitagaragara neza kubera ibiti?
options: Kugenda witonze, ugasuzuma uko umuhanda umeze kandi ugakurikiza amabwiriza uzi
answer: Kugenda witonze, ugasuzuma uko umuhanda umeze kandi ugakurikiza amabwiriza uzi
explanation: Ikimenyetso kitagaragara neza ntigisobanura ko nta kaga gahari. Kugenda witonze no kwitegereza umuhanda bifasha kwirinda impanuka.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora mbere yo gufungura urugi rw'imodoka yahagaze ku ruhande rw'umuhanda?
options: Kureba niba nta mumotari, umunyegare cyangwa ikindi kinyabiziga kiza inyuma
answer: Kureba niba nta mumotari, umunyegare cyangwa ikindi kinyabiziga kiza inyuma
explanation: Urugi rufunguwe rutunguranye rushobora kugonga umunyegare cyangwa umumotari. Banza urebe inyuma n'uruhande rw'urugi mbere yo kurufungura.

question: Kuki umushoferi agomba guhanagura ikirahuri cy'imbere mbere yo gutwara?
options: Kugira ngo abone umuhanda, ibimenyetso n'abandi bakoresha umuhanda neza
answer: Kugira ngo abone umuhanda, ibimenyetso n'abandi bakoresha umuhanda neza
explanation: Ikirahuri kirimo umwanda, igihu cyangwa amazi gishobora kubangamira kureba. Kubona neza ni ingenzi mu gufata ibyemezo bikwiye igihe utwaye.

question: Iyo ubonye umwana ari hafi y'umuhanda, ni iyihe myitwarire ikwiye?
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko no kwitegura guhagarara
explanation: Abana bashobora kwiruka cyangwa kwambuka batabanje kureba. Umushoferi agomba kubateganyiriza umutekano, cyane cyane hafi y'amashuri n'ahatuwe.

question: Ni iki ugomba gukora iyo imodoka itangiye kugira ikibazo mu gihe uri mu muhanda?
options: Guhagarara ahatekanye uko bishoboka no gushyiraho ibimenyetso byo kuburira abandi igihe bikenewe
Kongera umuvuduko kugira ngo ikibazo gishire
answer: Guhagarara ahatekanye uko bishoboka no gushyiraho ibimenyetso byo kuburira abandi igihe bikenewe
explanation: Imodoka ifite ikibazo ishobora guteza impanuka iyo ihagaritswe ahantu habi. Shaka ahatekanye kandi uburire abandi bakoresha umuhanda mu buryo bwemewe.

question: Kuki gukurikira imodoka iri imbere hafi cyane ari bibi?
options: Bituma imodoka ikoresha lisansi nke buri gihe
Bigabanya igihe n'umwanya byo kwirinda kugongana iyo ihagaze gitunguranye
Bituma ibimenyetso byo ku muhanda birushaho kugaragara
answer: Bigabanya igihe n'umwanya byo kwirinda kugongana iyo ihagaze gitunguranye
explanation: Intera ihagije ituma ubona ibyago hakiri kare kandi ugahagarara utagonganye n'ikinyabiziga kiri imbere. Intera ikwiye igomba kwiyongera igihe umuhanda unyerera cyangwa kureba bigoye.

question: Ni iki umushoferi agomba gukora iyo amatara y'imodoka ye yanze gukora nijoro?
options: Gushaka ahatekanye agahagarara no gukemura ikibazo mbere yo gukomeza
Kugendera inyuma y'indi modoka hafi cyane
answer: Gushaka ahatekanye agahagarara no gukemura ikibazo mbere yo gukomeza
explanation: Amatara afasha umushoferi kubona no gutuma abandi bamubona. Gutwara nijoro amatara adakora bishobora guteza akaga gakomeye.

question: Iyo umuhanda ugabanutse ukaba umurongo umwe, ni iki ugomba gukora?
options: Kwiruka kugira ngo ube uwa mbere
Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibimenyetso no guha inzira abandi hakurikijwe amategeko
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibimenyetso no guha inzira abandi hakurikijwe amategeko
explanation: Ahantu umuhanda ugabanukira hakenera ubwitonzi n'ubufatanye. Ibimenyetso n'amategeko yo gutanga inzira ni byo bigena uko ibinyabiziga bikurikirana.

question: Kuki ugomba kugenzura ko imizigo ifashwe neza ku kinyabiziga?
options: Kugira ngo itagwa, itabangamira abandi cyangwa ngo ihindure imiterere y'ikinyabiziga
Kugira ngo imodoka igende yihuta kurushaho
Kugira ngo ibimenyetso byo ku muhanda bitagaragara
answer: Kugira ngo itagwa, itabangamira abandi cyangwa ngo ihindure imiterere y'ikinyabiziga
explanation: Umutwaro utari ufashwe neza ushobora kugwa mu muhanda cyangwa gutuma ikinyabiziga kitagenzurwa neza. Umutwaro ugomba gufatwa neza no kutarenga ibisabwa n'amategeko.

question: Iyo ubonye ikimenyetso kiburira ko imbere hari umuhanda w'amakorosi menshi, wakora iki?
options: Kunyura ku zindi modoka mu ikorosi
Kugabanya umuvuduko mbere yo kugera mu makorosi no kugenzura imodoka neza
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko mbere yo kugera mu makorosi no kugenzura imodoka neza
explanation: Amakorosi agabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona ibiri imbere kandi umuvuduko mwinshi ushobora gutuma imodoka ita umuhanda. Gabanya umuvuduko hakiri kare.

question: Ni iyihe mpamvu yo gukoresha umukandara w'umutekano n'iyo urugendo ari rugufi?
options: Ni uko urinda gusa imodoka nshya
Ni uko impanuka ishobora kuba no mu rugendo rugufi kandi umukandara ukagabanya ibyago byo gukomereka
Ni uko utuma imodoka ihagarara yonyine
answer: Ni uko impanuka ishobora kuba no mu rugendo rugufi kandi umukandara ukagabanya ibyago byo gukomereka
explanation: Impanuka ishobora kuba igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Umukandara ufashwe neza ugabanya ibyago byo gukomereka bikomeye igihe habaye kugongana cyangwa guhagarara gitunguranye.

question: Ni iki ugomba gukora iyo ugeze ahari ibikorwa byo gusana umuhanda?
options: Kugabanya umuvuduko, gukurikiza ibimenyetso by'agateganyo no kwitondera abakozi
answer: Kugabanya umuvuduko, gukurikiza ibimenyetso by'agateganyo no kwitondera abakozi
explanation: Ahari ibikorwa byo gusana umuhanda hashobora kuba inzira yagabanutse, abakozi cyangwa ibikoresho. Ibimenyetso by'agateganyo bifasha kurinda abakozi n'abagenzi.

question: Kuki ari bibi gutwara imodoka uri munsi y'ingaruka z'inzoga?
options: Kuko bituma umuntu yumva ibintu byose vuba
Kuko inzoga zibangamira ubushobozi bwo gufata ibyemezo, kureba no kugenzura imodoka
answer: Kuko inzoga zibangamira ubushobozi bwo gufata ibyemezo, kureba no kugenzura imodoka
explanation: Inzoga zigabanya ubwitonzi n'ubushobozi bwo kwitwara vuba igihe habaye ibyago. Ntugatware imodoka unyoye; koresha ubundi buryo bwizewe bwo kugenda.

question: Iyo ikinyabiziga kiri imbere gihagaritse gitunguranye, ni iki kigufasha kwirinda kugongana na cyo?
options: Kuba wasize intera ihagije kandi ugenda ku muvuduko ukwiye
answer: Kuba wasize intera ihagije kandi ugenda ku muvuduko ukwiye
explanation: Intera n'umuvuduko bikwiye biha umushoferi umwanya wo kubona ibyago, gufata icyemezo no guhagarara. Gukurikira hafi bigabanya cyane amahirwe yo kwirinda impanuka.
